reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Berry Glowing Sun Cream 50mL SPF50+ PA++++
reviews.text: Love this sunscreen. Does leave a white cast, but I prefer that because it evens out my skin tone. Moisturizing without being oily.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢支防曬。的確會泛白，但我反而鍾意，因為可以均勻膚色。保濕得嚟又唔油笠。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Berry Glowing Sun Cream 50mL SPF50+ PA++++
reviews.text: I love this stuff - I took it to the beach when I went with a friend and she was OBSSESSED with the packaging, so I ordered her one as soon as I got home and gave it to her later. She loves it too. One of the best sunscreens ever!
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢支！同朋友去沙灘帶咗去，佢一見到個包裝就勁著迷，我返到屋企即刻上網幫佢落單，之後送咗俾佢。佢都一樣鍾意。絕對係最好用嘅防曬之一！

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Berry Glowing Sun Cream 50mL SPF50+ PA++++
reviews.text: Lovely feel at first. Does have a noticeable white cast at first that takes a bit of time to work through. Leaves skin with a lighter look and matte finish. Unfortunately it does tend to pill unless you apply powder over the top.
reviews.zh: 上手感覺幾舒服。開頭的確有明顯嘅泛白，要花少少時間先推得開。搽完皮膚望落會白一啲，係霧面妝效。可惜唔搽粉壓住嘅話，會好容易搓泥。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Berry Glowing Sun Cream 50mL SPF50+ PA++++
reviews.text: It’s a very smooth formula. Layers well, has a pleasant scent, and very light. However, it does have a slight white cast that I’m sure would be even more noticeable on darker skin.
reviews.zh: 質地好滑順。容易疊塗，香味怡人，而且好輕。但係的確有少少泛白，喺深色皮膚上應該會更加明顯。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Berry Glowing Sun Cream 50mL SPF50+ PA++++
reviews.text: I haven't used it yet but the exterior packaging is soft, not a hard packaging just fyi.
reviews.zh: 我未用過，但係外盒包裝係軟嘅，唔係硬身嗰種，俾大家參考下。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Berry Glowing Sun Cream 50mL SPF50+ PA++++
reviews.text: It feels like beauty of joseon with bit thicker texture. Nice strawberry scent.
reviews.zh: 用落好似 beauty of joseon，但質地厚少少。有好聞嘅士多啤梨味。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Berry Glowing Sun Cream 50mL SPF50+ PA++++
reviews.text: I'm obsessed with how awesome this sunscreen is. It offers great protection and doesn't look like sunscreen.
reviews.zh: 我完全著迷於呢支防曬有幾正。防曬力強，但用落完全唔似防曬。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Berry Glowing Sun Cream 50mL SPF50+ PA++++
reviews.text: Good sunscreen, spreads and protects well; however, I did not get the 'glowing' aspect from it.
reviews.zh: 防曬唔錯，搽得開、防曬力都夠；但係我就真係搵唔到話有「水光」嘅效果。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
